svg.title: Lord of Earned Success: Six of Swords · Mercury in Aquarius · Tiphareth (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Mercury above the painting and Aquarius below, as Book T places them: "Mercury and Aquarius above and below, supported on the points of two short daggers or swords." The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/grammars/1791669735180-qnxtxdmc3on.jpg (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0).
